summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long CBRS Daily ETF (CBRG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Cerebras Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ: CBRS ) stock, less fees, and expenses CBRG was launched on May 15, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
